Faq.label: FAQ
Faq.heading: Questions authors usually ask.
Faq.q1: What files can I upload? What about images, tables, and footnotes?
Faq.a1: DOCX or PDF, up to 50 MB (5 to 300 pages). DOCX gives the best results: headings, lists, footnotes, tables, and inline images carry over with their structure. PDF support is in beta: text-based PDFs work, scanned or image-only PDFs don't, and footnotes, tables, and images inside a PDF may not be detected reliably.
Faq.a2: No. Racana is a formatting and typesetting tool. It does not rewrite, summarize, edit, or alter the text of your manuscript. Your words go in, and the same words come out — given a finished physical form.
Faq.q3: Can I see the result before paying?
Faq.a3: Yes. Upload your manuscript and preview the full typeset interior with a light watermark, free. You pay only when you want the clean files.
Faq.a4: 5 × 8″, 5.5 × 8.5″, 6 × 9″, and 8.5 × 11″, the most common paperback sizes on Amazon KDP, Pothi, and IngramSpark.
Faq.a5: Your files sit on encrypted storage and are used only to build your book. Raw manuscripts are kept for 30 days so you can re-download and revise, then deleted. If AI-assisted structure detection is enabled on our servers, a short opening excerpt (up to ~8,000 characters) is processed by the configured language-model endpoint solely to detect title, author and chapter metadata. We never edit your text, train models on it, or sell it. Email books@racana.pro to have your files deleted sooner.
Faq.a6: English, plus Devanagari (Hindi, Marathi, Sanskrit), Tamil, and Malayalam, with the fonts embedded in your PDF. Mixed-script manuscripts work: each script picks up the right font automatically. Other Indic scripts, including Bengali, aren't supported for print yet.
Faq.q7: Does Racana design my book cover and create eBooks?
Faq.a7: Yes. Every paid book includes Cover Studio, which produces a print cover PDF with the spine width calculated from your page count, plus an EPUB 3 export for Kindle and Google Play Books.
Faq.q8: Can I re-generate after fixing a typo?
Faq.a8: Yes, free. Correct your source file and re-generate the interior, cover, and EPUB as many times as you need, without paying again.

FinalCta.headingB: Now give it a finished interior.
FinalCta.subCta: Free watermarked preview · ₹2,450 to unlock clean PDF, cover & EPUB
